raw_text: Reviewer (member_002) ready. I'll independently adopt and test your exact published candidate. Publish a fixed candidate with fix_patch then handoff_patch to me. Context for the fix: likely bug is in src/_pytest/capture.py — FDCapture should write to a TempCaptureIO (io.TextIOWrapper over io.BytesIO) so newline translation is avoided, instead of using TemporaryFile which applies os.linesep translation. Let me know when published.

Reviewer (member_002) here — independent baseline analysis done, sharing so you can target the fix precisely. Please publish with fix_patch + handoff_patch when ready; I will integrate and test that exact version.

MY EMPIRICAL BASELINE (unmodified repo, my tree v2, report test-report-8b1e2fb2bad034bdac49c310):
- test_capfd_cr_repro.py::test_cafd_includes_carriage_return -> FAILED
- test_capfd_cr_repro.py::test_cafd_stderr_cr -> FAILED
- test_capfd_cr_repro.py::test_capsys_cr -> PASSED
So the defect is FD-capture-only; sys capture already behaves.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed by reading src/_pytest/capture.py):
- CaptureIO.__init__ (line ~195) already passes newline="" -> capsys correct.
- EncodedFile(io.TextIOWrapper) (~line 177) defines only __slots__/name/mode, NO __init__, so no newline control.
- FDCaptureBinary.__init__ (~line 404) builds EncodedFile(TemporaryFile(buffering=0), encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", write_through=True) with NO newline -> TextIOWrapper default newline=None applies universal-newline translation, writing '\r' as os.linesep ('\n'). FDCapture.snap() then reads back the already-mangled text.

CRITICAL CONSTRAINT (please do not violate):
- FDCaptureBinary.start()/resume() call os.dup2(self.tmpfile.fileno(), self.targetfd). So the wrapper must still expose a REAL temp-file fileno. A fix that swaps in io.BytesIO for the fd path would break fd capture (BytesIO has no fileno) — I would have to request changes.

ACCEPTABLE MINIMAL FIX (either is fine):
(a) Give EncodedFile an __init__ that sets newline="" (e.g. kwargs.setdefault("newline", "") before super().__init__), or
(b) pass newline="" explicitly at the FDCaptureBinary call site.

I WILL ACCEPT only if all of these hold on your exact published version:
1) test_cafd_includes_carriage_return passes: print('Greetings from DOS', end='\r'); out from capfd.readouterr() endswith '\r'.
2) capfd stderr keeps '\r' (borg '  0%\r' case).
3) capsys behavior unchanged (no newline regression).
4) testing/test_capture.py passes (suspend/resume, fd capture, tmpfile name/mode props).
5) A regression test for the \r case is added to the repo, plus a changelog entry (changelog/*.bugfix.rst) consistent with repo convention.

Reply/hand off the patch ID when published.
